Pricing

A clear scope and a written price before you commit.

Website Development

Custom quote

Business websites, landing pages and web applications. Your proposal lists the pages, features, integrations, revisions, delivery milestones and any hosting or maintenance costs included in your project.

Mobile App Development

Custom quote

iOS and Android projects are priced according to the screens, user accounts, integrations and release requirements. Store fees, external services and ongoing support are listed separately when applicable.

Software Subscriptions and Licenses

Product specific pricing

Subscription and license prices depend on the product, plan, users and features. The applicable product page or written offer will state the exact price, currency, billing period, limits and renewal terms before purchase. DevMania does not currently offer a general software checkout on this website.

What Your Quote Includes

Before payment, we confirm deliverables, exclusions, payment milestones, taxes where applicable and third party costs. Extra features require an agreed change to the scope. Maintenance is optional unless your written agreement says otherwise.
